title: Concept: Table and column names returned in a response
description: A table name paired with a list of its columns in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The list gives the exact schema vocabulary an attacker needs to write a working injection, including columns the UI never shows.
applicability: Deployments that render a table name paired with a list of its columns into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The list gives the exact schema vocabulary an attacker needs to write a working injection, including columns the UI never shows.
